def proj_out(vecs, M):
    _, S, Vt = np.linalg.svd(M, full_matrices=False)
    V = Vt[S > 1e-7 * S[0]]

    G = np.array([np.mean(Wq[h, 256:, :] * sw, axis=0) for h in range(8)])

        out_s.append(f"H{h}:{s0:.2f}->{s1:.2f}({s1/s0:.2f}x)")
